full_prompt_en: A square Renaissance oil portrait shows an elderly man in strict left-facing profile. His pale gray hair emerges from beneath a soft brown cap, and his high forehead, long nose and closed mouth form a clean contour against a dark architectural recess. He wears a nearly black high-collared garment, its folds and seams carefully described but held back in shadow. At the left edge, a pale carved column and small capital mark a formal stone setting. Another gray column appears behind his shoulder on the right, while a rough mottled wall fills the upper background. The face takes the greatest share of light. Warm ivory and quiet ochre tones model the forehead, cheek and ear, then turn to gray along the jaw and hair. There is little visible action or expression; the subject's still gaze toward the left and the exact silhouette give the image a contemplative, ceremonial calm. The cap's rust brown breaks the predominantly stone gray and black palette, becoming a second focal shape above the face. Brushwork is smooth and controlled across skin, more textured in stone and dark cloth. Small variations of highlight on the garment prevent it from flattening into a single black mass. The close crop emphasizes the head and shoulders, while the vertical architecture gives an ordered frame for the measured profile.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形文艺复兴油画肖像呈现一位严格朝左侧面的老者。浅灰头发从柔软棕帽下露出，高额、长鼻与紧闭嘴唇在深色建筑凹处前形成干净轮廓。他穿近黑色高领衣服，褶线与接缝描述细致，却退在阴影里。左边缘一根浅色雕刻柱及小柱头标出正式石造空间。右侧肩后还有一根灰柱，粗糙斑驳墙面填满上部背景。面部承接最多光。暖象牙色与安静赭色塑造额头、脸颊和耳朵，到下颌及头发转为灰色。画中几乎没有动作或强烈表情；向左的静视与准确剪影使形象沉思而庄严。帽子的锈棕色打断石灰和黑色为主的色盘，成为脸上方第二焦点形状。皮肤笔触平滑克制，石面与暗布料更富纹理。衣服上的细小亮度变化避免它变成一整块平黑。近距离裁切突出头肩，竖向建筑为谨慎的侧面形体提供有序框架。
style_prompt_en: The Renaissance oil painting depends on measured profile geometry and controlled tonal modeling. Warm ivory and russet are set against stone gray, olive brown and near black. Soft side light gives rounded planes quiet depth, while clear contours hold the focal shape. Smooth passages on illuminated surfaces contrast with mottled masonry and restrained cloth texture. Vertical framing and a narrow palette create formal stillness; small shifts within the dark field keep the surface alive.
style_prompt_zh: 这种文艺复兴油画依靠严谨的侧向几何与克制调子塑造。暖象牙色、赤褐色置于石灰、橄榄棕与近黑之间。柔和侧光赋予圆转平面安静深度，清晰轮廓保持焦点形体。受光表面的平滑段落对照斑驳石面和节制布纹。竖向框架与狭窄色盘带来正式静止感，暗色区域里的小幅变化让表面仍有生命。
theme_en: An elderly man in profile wearing a brown cap
theme_zh: 戴棕帽的老者侧面肖像
name: Giovanni Bellini
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
